1657.e: The government could require owners to sell selected farmland so it can become a nature reserve. Owners would receive money as compensation, but they could not simply refuse the sale. We want solidarity with people facing repression, access to legal help and equal treatment for workers. We would defend asylum rather than turn immigration status into a criminal offence. We support ending political asylum and using criminal courts to enforce rules on unauthorised entry and stay. We want government to maintain strict control over who enters and remains in the country.
